description: Configuration for TDK Landscape resources. Drives Tilt orchestration, Docker Compose generation, and dependency resolution. Supports both explicit service.json files and synthesis from directory structure.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE validation

apiBasePath.description: Base path for API routes in Traefik.

appType.description:
Resource type determining build strategy:
• backend - Hono/Express API server
• frontend - Vite single-page application (React, Vue, Svelte, Preact, Lit, Solid, Qwik or Vanilla TypeScript, see framework)
• sdk - Shared library package
• worker - Background job processor
• migrator - Database migration runner
• library - Shared code library
• mcp - Model Context Protocol server (an HTTP service on Bun, run like a backend)
• bring-your-own - Wrap an existing service. No app scaffold. Needs Dockerfile or --image.

backendName.description:
For frontends: associated backend resource.
Auto-computed from appName if not specified.

basePath.description: Base path for frontend routing on TDK Landscape.localhost. Default is /{stack}s when omitted.

databaseName.description:
Override auto-generated DB name.
Default: TDK_{stack}

dockerfile.description: Custom Dockerfile path relative to resource directory. Optional for bring-your-own type.

buildContext.description: Docker build context for a bring-your-own resource, relative to the resource directory. Defaults to the resource directory. When set, dockerfile is relative to this context.

exposeViaProxy.description: Whether this bring-your-own resource receives a Traefik route. Defaults to true.

restart.description: Docker Compose restart policy for this bring-your-own resource. Use "no" or "on-failure" for one-shot jobs such as database migrations, so a finished job is not restarted. Defaults to unless-stopped.

image.description: Docker image name instead of building from Dockerfile. Optional for bring-your-own type.

params.description: Non-secret configuration parameters (BASE_URL, PORT, etc.). Secrets use 'secrets' section below.

secrets.description: Names of secrets the resource needs. By default each is read from the project .env (gitignored) and injected into the container; with TDK_SECRET_PROVIDER=infisical they are left to Infisical. NO secret values in params/envVars or anywhere in service.json.

required.description: Required secret names. The resource does not start if any is missing from the project .env.

optional.description: Optional secret names. The resource starts with the variable empty when it is missing from the project .env.

featuresEnabled.description:
Platform features:
• nats - NATS JetStream eventing
• prisma - DB ORM & migrations
• redis - Caching layer
• infisical - Secrets management
• vitest - Test framework
• traefik - Reverse proxy routing
• websocket - WS support
• graphql - GraphQL server
• grpc - gRPC protocol
• vite, tsconfig, dockerfile, nginx, ... - generator features that `tdk resource` writes into new files

framework.description: Framework provider id. For frontend resources it selects the Vite and TypeScript config (omitted means react, legacy manifests). For backend resources it selects the HTTP framework on the Bun runtime (omitted means hono; not used with a language that owns its runtime, such as python). Valid ids come from the CLI provider registries, which reject unknown ids before writing a resource.

language.description: Backend language provider id used to scaffold and run the service. Only meaningful for backend resources; omitted means bun (legacy manifests). Valid ids come from the CLI provider registry.

healthCheckPath.description: HTTP endpoint for health checks. Must return 200 OK. Optional for bring-your-own: omit it for a service that does not speak HTTP (Postgres, Redis, SMTP, ...), and TDK then skips the HTTP health probes for it.

dependsOn.description:
Resource dependencies used for startup ordering and frontend dependency env generation.
Each entry can be a stack (e.g. 'service') or resource name (e.g. 'user-admin-api').
Resources listed here start before this resource. Used for focus mode, health checks, migration order.

nats.description: Custom NATS configuration. Auto-generated if 'nats' in featuresEnabled.

queueGroup.description: NATS queue group for load balancing

playwright.description: Generate Playwright config in .autogenerated/playwright.config.autogenerated.ts when true.

port.description:
External dev port (internal always 3000).
Assignments:
• 4000: user
• 4001: service
• 4002: order
• 4003: team
• 4004: auth

replicas.description:
Container instances to run.
Creates separate containers (resource-1, resource-2).
Traefik load-balances between all replicas.

runtime.description: Runtime to use for this resource

schemaVersion.description: Version of the TDK service manifest contract.

sablier.description:
On-demand scaling: stop this container when idle, wake it on the next request.
Not recommended for databases or other stateful resources with in-flight writes.
(Premium - requires TDK_LICENSE_KEY; see hasSablierLicense() in extension-fetch.ts)

enable.description: Scale this resource to zero when idle

deferStart.description: Build the image during tdk up, then create and start the container on its first request

group.description: Resources sharing a group wake and sleep together. Defaults to `stack`.

sessionDuration.description: How long the resource stays up after its last request (Go duration, e.g. "10m", "1h").

syncs.description:
Directories to sync for hot-reload.
Auto-computed if not specified:
• backend: ['src', 'prisma']
• frontend: ['src', 'public']

smoke.description: Post-start check run by `tdk up` through the public proxy URL (not inside the container): write a record, read it back. `tdk up` fails if a step misses. Absent means no smoke check. Workers and resources with exposeViaProxy false are skipped.

via.description: Only `proxy` is supported: the request goes to the URL `tdk up` prints.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the route to come up. Connection errors and 404/502/503/504 are retried until then; any other wrong answer fails at once.

name.description: Optional display name for this check.

path.description: Appended to the service's public base URL. `{{name}}` is replaced by a value saved by an earlier step.

expect.description: Expected HTTP status code, from 100 through 599.

bodyContains.description: Optional text that must occur in the response body.

save.description: Saves response fields for later steps, for example {"id": "$.id"}.

steps.description: Non-empty ordered list of HTTP checks to run after the resource starts.

traefik.description: Custom Traefik routing. Auto-generated if not specified.

type.description: Legacy alias for appType, still read from older service.json files. Use appType in new files.

enabled.description: Whether this resource is enabled in its project configuration.

apiPath.description: API path exposed by this resource, when applicable.

title: TDK Landscape Resource Configuration
